laws.name: LEY DE COHERENCIA TRIPLE (Excel ↔ JSON ↔ lista)
laws.statement: Excel, JSON y lista emitida deben quedar coherentes en todo cambio.
evidence: P1: Excel 3840x2160 → JSON 7680x4320 → lista 3840x2160 y L123/L120 → audit/alignment/2026-10-25/90-matriz/_raw/canon_vs_json.json · sha256:F8B82BEF70B1… + audit/alignment/2026-10-25/90-matriz/_raw/PHYS_served_streaminf_by_profile.txt · sha256:FD2CD091C440…
P3: Excel 1080p/Main10 L123 → JSON 4K/Main 8-bit L120 → lista 1080p/L150+L123 → idem
P4: Excel 720p/Main10 L93 → JSON 4K/AVC → lista 1080p/L150+L123 → idem
P5: Excel 480p/AVC → JSON 4K/AVC → lista 1080p/L150+L123 → idem
